mainEntity.name: How does CatalystLab compare to Google PageSpeed Insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: While PageSpeed Insights focuses solely on client-side Lighthouse performance and Core Web Vitals, CatalystLab combines 8 diagnostic engines into a unified audit: DOM complexity, OWASP security headers, WCAG 2.2 accessibility compliance, serverless eco-carbon footprints, global edge latency across 12 worldwide PoPs, and /llms.txt AI search readiness.

Yes, CatalystLab provides free on-demand audits across all 8 diagnostic engines with instant shareable permalink dossiers (/reports/:slug). Pro and Enterprise tiers add automated 60-minute health probes, CI/CD quality gate webhooks, and private subdomain scanning.

mainEntity.name: Can I test edge latency across multiple global regions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, CatalystLab includes a Global Edge Latency Radar that measures TTFB, DNS resolution, and TCP handshake times across 12 worldwide edge nodes including US East, US West, Frankfurt, London, Singapore, Tokyo, Sydney, and São Paulo.
